name: Text: AI Chatbot, Live Chat & Ticketing for Customer Service
author: Text

sections.description:
Text is an AI-powered customer service platform — live chat, AI agent, help desk, and ticketing in one workspace. Install the plugin on your WordPress site in minutes, connect your account, and the AI starts handling conversations the same day.

No developer needed. 14-day free trial, no credit card required.

🤖 AI Agent That Resolves, Sells, and Generates Leads

AI agent in Text is trained on your website data and knowledge base. Point it at your site — it reads your content, understands context, and starts helping visitors the same day.

How training works: You give the AI your website URL, help articles, PDFs, or product catalogs. It builds its knowledge base automatically.

The AI resolves conversations end-to-end — order status, returns, FAQs, product specs — in multiple languages, 24/7, with automatic translation built in. Text customers see a 74% AI resolution rate versus 59% industry average. Fewer tickets on your team, more time for important conversations.

Resolution is only the starting point:

  • Checkout hesitation? The AI steps in with a relevant offer.
  • Purchase intent on a product page? It starts the right conversation.
  • Question about an existing order? It recommends next steps.

These aren’t cold pitches — they’re helpful nudges at moments that convert.

AI delivers rich response formats — product cards, carousels, quick replies, buttons — so conversations feel interactive, not robotic. Persistent chat history means returning visitors pick up right where they left off.

Because the AI trains on your data — not generic internet content — it sounds like your brand:

  • Fine-tune tone, answer length, and personality
  • Configure behaviors for different pages, audiences, or times of day
  • AI adapts to your business

Core Features

💬 Live Chat, Human Handoff, and Copilot

Live chat connects your WordPress site to Text’s unified inbox. See who’s online, what they’re browsing, where they came from. Routing rules send conversations to the right agent. Proactive triggers engage visitors before they ask.

How does the AI handle conversations it can’t resolve? — human handoff. The AI doesn’t just transfer — it summarizes the conversation, collects customer details, and hands your agent full context.

Copilot. A separate AI assistant for your agents — reply suggestions, chat summaries, relevant knowledge base content, all in real-time. Copilot makes them faster.

🤖 AI Agent

Most chatbot plugins connect to a generic AI. Text’s AI agent is different — it’s trained on your data, speaks in your brand voice, and understands commercial context: what’s in the cart, browsed pages, purchase history.

Teach it new workflows in plain language — no code, no decision trees, no waiting on developers.

⚡ Custom Skills

Custom skills let you quickly teach your AI agent to qualify leads, capture contact details, offer discounts, route VIPs, create support tickets, schedule appointments — and more. No coding required.

Anyone on your team can build AI workflows that previously required a developer. One team built their most effective skill in thirty seconds with a single sentence.

Custom skills work with intent detection. The AI doesn’t wait for questions, it starts conversations on its own.

🎫 Help Desk and Ticketing

The ticketing system handles automated tagging, SLA tracking, escalation workflows, satisfaction ratings, workload visibility, and email — all in one inbox.

Agent collaboration features — chat transfer, escalation rules, internal notes — keep complex issues moving. For agencies and resellers, white-label options let you deploy Text under your own brand.

🎯 Campaigns and Lead Generation

Text doesn’t wait for visitors to click. Proactive campaigns engage based on behavior — time on page, scroll depth, exit intent, cart value — then capture contact details, qualify prospects, and route high-value leads to your team with full context.

The conversational form builder lets you create structured data collection flows that feel natural inside the chat. No clunky pop-ups. No redirects to external contact form pages. The visitor answers questions inside the chatbot window, and the data flows directly into your CRM or email platform. With conversation forms built into the chat flow, you capture structured data without interrupting the natural conversation.

For ecommerce specifically, user conversions improve when the AI engages visitors at the right moment. Text detects buying patterns and acts — increasing customer conversion rate by meeting buyers where they are in the journey. Lead generation runs around the clock.

⚙️ Automation and Integrations

No-code workflows connect Text to HubSpot, Slack, Mailchimp, and more. Trigger-based actions handle tagging, routing, follow-ups, CRM updates, and notifications automatically. Ticket rules manage escalation, SLA enforcement, and feedback collection. Webhook support connects Text to virtually any system.

📊 Measure Profit

Text measures what matters — resolution rate, satisfaction, response times, agent performance, and cost per conversation. Unlike most platforms, it separates results by manual, AI-assisted, and fully automated. You see exactly where value is coming from.

Revenue attribution shows what the AI sells, saves, and surfaces. Feedback collects automatically through post-chat surveys and satisfaction ratings. This is the difference between a chat bot that reports on volume and a customer service platform that reports on value.

Topic detection highlights what customers ask about most, so you can fix what’s broken and double down on what works.

🔐 Security and Compliance

  • SOC 2
  • GDPR and CCPA
  • PCI DSS
  • Role-based access with admin and member permissions
  • Multi-brand support with brand-level data separation
  • Dedicated private server option for enterprise clients
  • Controls to disable persistent chat history and manage data retention

See more audits, certifications, subprocessors, and data processing practices in Text’s Trust Center.

💰 Pricing

Text’s pricing plans start at $19/month. Three tiers — Essential, Growth, and Enterprise — with AI resolutions included at each level (10, 200, and 2,000+ per month). Additional resolutions available in packages of 50.

Every plan includes the AI chatbot, live chat, help desk, and ticketing system. 14-day free trial with full access to advanced features — no credit card required.

💬 Live Chat for WordPress That Actually Works

Text’s live chat plugin sits within the same unified inbox as your AI chatbot, email support, ticketing system, and social channels. No tab-switching. No lost context. One workspace for everything.

When a conversation needs a human, the AI doesn’t just transfer — it prepares. It collects customer details, summarizes the conversation, and hands your agent a warm handoff with full context — who they’re talking to, what they’ve asked, and what they need.

🧑‍✈️ Copilot for Human Agents

Copilot is a real-time AI assistant for your agents — reply suggestions, chat summaries, relevant knowledge base content. Agents respond faster, handle more, and don’t burn out.

👀 Real-Time Visitor Tracking

See who’s on your site right now, what they’re browsing, and where they came from. Live visitor tracking lets your team start proactive conversations based on actual behavior — not guesswork.

Combined with intelligent routing, the right agent gets the right conversation instantly — by skill, context, or account value. No manual assignment, no delays.

🌐 Omnichannel Messaging — Every Channel, One Inbox

Your customers don’t stick to one channel. Text brings live chat, email, Facebook Messenger, Instagram, and more into one omnichannel inbox — full conversation history per contact, no blind spots. Not integrations duct-taped together. One inbox, built for it.

🌙 Offline Messaging and After-Hours AI Coverage

When no one’s online, the AI keeps working — capturing leads, qualifying visitors, and collecting context for follow-up. Your team wakes up to warm leads, not a backlog. 24/7 support without the 24/7 headcount.

🎫 Help Desk and Ticketing System Built for WordPress

Text includes a full help desk and ticketing system — not as an add-on, but as a core part of the platform. Create, assign, and track support tickets without leaving the conversation.

📋 Ticket Management That Scales

Every conversation can become a ticket with full context: browsing history, order data, previous conversations, internal notes.

  • Automated tagging and routing based on conversation content
  • Priority levels and SLA tracking
  • Escalation workflows when SLAs are at risk
  • Satisfaction ratings and post-chat surveys
  • Team management with workload visibility
  • Response times, resolution rates, and agent performance reports

Email ticketing routes into the same inbox as chat and social. Self-service portal. White-label options for agencies and resellers.

🛒 AI Agent for eCommerce and WooCommerce

WooCommerce and Shopify integration gives your AI and human agents real-time access to order data, cart contents, and browsing history — right inside the conversation. Order tracking, product recommendations, and return flows run automatically. Your team focuses on conversations that need a human touch.

🌍 Multilingual Support for Global WordPress Websites

Text supports multiple languages with automatic translation built into the AI engine. Your AI chatbot responds in your visitor’s language automatically — no separate bots, no manual translation.

One AI agent serves your entire global audience — whether your site gets traffic from Berlin, São Paulo, or Tokyo. Multilingual support isn’t a premium add-on — it’s how the product works.

Under the hood, Text uses NLP and vector database embedding technology to understand meaning, not just match keywords.

🔗 Integration With Your Existing Stack

Text connects to WooCommerce, Shopify, HubSpot, Slack, Zapier, and more. Automated tagging, routing, follow-ups, and escalation rules run without manual work. Webhook support connects Text to virtually any system.

The plugin installs in clicks from your WordPress dashboard — no coding, no complex configuration. Customize the widget’s appearance, behavior, and placement directly from Text.

Text also works as a knowledge base plugin for your WordPress site. The AI learns from your existing content — pages, posts, product descriptions, help articles — and uses that knowledge to answer user questions accurately. As your site updates, so does the AI. No retraining required.

🔄 Customer Experience Across the Entire Journey

Implementing chatbots is only valuable if they fit into the broader customer experience. Text isn’t a standalone chat widget — it covers the entire customer journey from first visit to repeat purchase.

A visitor lands on your site. The AI tracks their behavior, starts the right conversation, and routes to a human when needed — with full context. After the purchase, it handles support. Every touchpoint is connected, every conversation makes the AI smarter and your team more effective. From first click to loyal customer.

🎨 Chat Widget Customization

The chat widget adapts to your brand — colors, position, greeting messages, avatar, launcher style. Show it on specific pages, hide it on others, trigger it by behavior, or limit it to business hours.

Focus browser tab flashing alerts your agents when new messages arrive. Bot notification sounds keep your team responsive. The widget is fully responsive — it looks and works properly on every device, every screen size, every WordPress theme.

🛡️ Disable Persistent Chat History

For businesses operating under strict data privacy regulations, Text offers controls to disable persistent chat history and manage data retention policies. GDPR compliance isn’t an afterthought — it’s built into how the platform handles customer data from day one.

⚙️ Installation

Installing Text on your WordPress site takes minutes:

  • Log into your WordPress dashboard.
  • Go to Plugins and click Add New.
  • Search for “Text” in the plugin directory.
  • Install the plugin and activate it.
  • Connect your Text account — or create one directly from the WordPress backend.
  • The AI chatbot starts learning from your website data immediately.

No API key configuration. No developer required. No PHP based system tweaks. The plug’n’play setup means you go from installation to handling conversations in the same session. The plugin is actively maintained — issues like undefined index issue fixed promptly, with regular updates and a tutorial link added to the plugin settings page so you’re never stuck.

🏢 Who Uses Text

Text is built for ecommerce and digital-first businesses — from growing online stores to enterprise teams. Whether you need to provide automated customer support for your WooCommerce shop, generate leads from your WordPress site, improve user engagement, or increase customer satisfaction without scaling headcount — Text is the WordPress chatbot and customer service platform that does it all.

Over 35,000 companies trust Text, including Unilever, Wembley Stadium, and MIT.

Your support team already talks to more potential buyers than sales does. Text makes sure those conversations count.

Great service sells.

External services

This plugin relies on Text (text.com), a third-party customer service and AI chatbot platform, to provide its core functionality.

Account connection

When you click “Connect to Text”, the plugin redirects your browser to Text’s account management API at https://api.text.com. The following data is sent as part of this request:

  • WordPress admin email address
  • WordPress site URL and admin URL
  • PHP version, WordPress version, and plugin version
  • WooCommerce version (if WooCommerce is active)

This data is used by Text to pre-fill your account setup and associate the plugin installation with your Text account.

Chat widget

Once connected, the plugin loads a JavaScript chat widget on your site’s frontend pages. This widget is served from Text’s CDN and enables real-time customer conversations. Visitor interaction data (such as chat messages and browsing context) is processed by Text’s servers as part of normal widget operation.

This service is provided by Text, Inc:
– Terms of service
– Privacy policy
sections.installation:
1. In your WordPress admin dashboard, go to Plugins → Add New.
  2. Search for “AI Chatbot by Text”
  3. Click Install Now, then Activate.
  4. Open the plugin from the WordPress sidebar.
  5. Click Connect to Text, then sign in to your existing Text account or create a new one.

No API key configuration. No developer required. No PHP based system tweaks. The plug’n’play setup means you go from installation to handling conversations in the same session. The plugin is actively maintained — issues like undefined index issue fixed promptly, with regular updates and a tutorial link added to the plugin settings page so you’re never stuck.

Point the AI agent at your WordPress site and it’s handling conversations the same day. That’s not a promise — that’s how the product works.
sections.faq:
How much does the Text AI chatbot for WordPress cost?

Text offers a free version and three paid plans — Essential, Growth, and Enterprise. AI resolutions are included at every tier, so you never pay extra for the AI to handle conversations. A 14-day free trial with no credit card required.

Does Text work with WooCommerce?

Yes. Text integrates natively with WooCommerce — real-time access to order data, cart contents, and browsing history inside the conversation. Order tracking, product recommendations, and returns work automatically.

Can Text handle multiple languages?

Yes. The AI responds in your visitor’s language automatically — no separate bots, no manual configuration. Multilingual support works across live chat, email, and social.

How does Text compare to other chatbot plugins for WordPress?

Most chatbot plugins focus on deflecting questions or connecting to external AI services like OpenAI or ChatGPT. Text is a complete customer service platform — AI chatbot, live chat software, help desk, ticketing system, and omnichannel messaging in one product. Unlike plugins that serve as wrappers around third-party AI services, Text’s AI is purpose-built for customer service. It’s trained on your own knowledge base, detects buying signals, qualifies leads, and turns support into a revenue channel.

Is Text GDPR compliant?

Yes. Text is SOC 2 audited, GDPR and CCPA compliant, and PCI DSS certified. You can configure data retention policies and disable persistent chat history to meet your organization’s privacy requirements.

Do I need technical knowledge to set up Text?

No. The WordPress plugin installs in clicks. The AI chatbot trains itself on your website data automatically. Custom skills are built in plain language — no coding, no drag and drop form builder, no engineering involvement. The natural language processing behind the AI engine handles the complexity — you just tell it what to do in plain English.

How does the AI handle conversations it can’t resolve?

The artificial intelligence knows when to step back. When a conversation requires human judgment — a complex complaint, a high-value negotiation, a sensitive issue — the AI transfers the conversation to a human agent with full context attached. The chat transfer includes a full summary — conversation history, customer details, order and browsing data.

Can I use Text for appointment scheduling?

Yes. Custom skills let you build appointment scheduling flows inside the chatbot — collecting times, contact details, and context, then pushing data to your calendar via webhook or native integration. No external booking plugin required.

Can I customize the chat widget?

Yes. Colors, position, greeting messages, launcher style — all configurable. Show or hide on specific pages, schedule when it appears, set separate behaviors for desktop and mobile. Chat widget customization is available on all plans.

What kind of support does Text offer?

Email support, in-app support, and dedicated account management depending on your plan. Enterprise customers get a dedicated account manager.

Can Text replace my current help desk software?

Yes. Text includes a full ticketing system — automated routing, SLA management, priority levels, escalation workflows, agent collaboration, internal notes, and chat transfer.

How does the AI agent learn about my business?

The AI agent trains on your website data and knowledge base automatically — no generic AI models, no third-party data. You can also upload additional training data, add FAQs, and fine tune responses to match your brand’s tone of voice. The AI improves with every customer interaction.
